sections_en.text: This document sets out the tests carried out on the unit; the purpose of these tests is to test the operation of the protection devices installed on the turbine. They are carried out after the periodic maintenance work is finished and before the unit is connected to the grid, to ensure the protection devices of the unit operate correctly, so as to guarantee their operation in the event of any fault in the unit during operation.

The document was prepared by Eng. Ayman Mohamed Abdel Magid, reviewed and tested by Eng. Mohamed Abdel Mohsen, approved by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras, General Manager, and approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of the Assiut Steam Power Station Sector; it was certified by Eng. Gamal El-Din Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and MPIS Coordinator of the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company.
The unit is out of service and the maintenance work on it has been completed

Carry out the trip test on loss of vacuum by cancelling the simulation on the two vacuum measurement transmitters, addresses %B0D5 and %B0D9; the turbine trips instantaneously.

Carry out the vibration test; to carry out this test the turbine shaft speed must be greater than 2%, i.e. greater than 37 rpm, and the vibration sensors are located on turbine bearings 1, 3 and 4

Simulate '1' on bearing '4' to produce a high 1 signal, address B630
Simulate '1' on bearing '4' to produce a high 2 signal, address B730

For the turbine to trip on vibration protection, a high 1 signal must appear from any bearing and a high 2 signal from another bearing at the same time (this is done by connecting the computer to CH1)
Carry out the turbine trip test on a drop in bearing lubricating oil pressure to 0.6 PL

Carry out the turbine trip test on a drop in bearing lubricating oil pressure to 0.4 PL, with the DC emergency pump starting
Carry out the turbine emergency trip test from the thermal room
Carry out the turbine emergency trip test by means of the red handle on the turbine body
Carry out the turbine trip test when the turbine speed reaches zero

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Power Stations | Maintenance Procedures
Introduction
This document sets out the tests carried out on the unit; the purpose of these tests is to test the operation of the protection devices installed on the turbine. They are carried out after the periodic maintenance work is finished and before the unit is connected to the grid, to ensure the protection devices of the unit operate correctly, so as to guarantee their operation in the event of any fault in the unit during operation.
The document was prepared by Eng. Ayman Mohamed Abdel Magid, reviewed and tested by Eng. Mohamed Abdel Mohsen, approved by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras, General Manager, and approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of the Assiut Steam Power Station Sector; it was certified by Eng. Gamal El-Din Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and MPIS Coordinator of the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions

Simulate 85% to trip on high bearing '4' metal temperature, address %B0C4 | 6.

Carry out the Turbomax test, i.e. thermal stresses on the turbine shaft, by making a 20% difference between the two signals, %B0D2 and %D0C3, and the following signals appear: TT52 MEASUREMENT, LIMETER52, TURBINE TRIP | 8.
Carry out the trip test on loss of vacuum by cancelling the simulation on the two vacuum measurement transmitters, addresses %B0D5 and %B0D9; the turbine trips instantaneously. | 9.
Carry out the trip test on loss of vacuum after 10 minutes, by cancelling the simulation on one of the vacuum measurement transmitters, addresses %B0D5 or %B0D9 | 10.
Carry out the vibration test; to carry out this test the turbine shaft speed must be greater than 2%, i.e. greater than 37 rpm, and the vibration sensors are located on turbine bearings 1, 3 and 4
Simulate '1' on bearing '1' to produce a high 1 signal, address B031 | 1.
Simulate '1' on bearing '1' to produce a high 2 signal, address B032 | 2.
Simulate '1' on bearing '3' to produce a high 1 signal, address B430 | 3.
Simulate '1' on bearing '3' to produce a high 2 signal, address B530 | 4.
Simulate '1' on bearing '4' to produce a high 1 signal, address B630 | 5.
Simulate '1' on bearing '4' to produce a high 2 signal, address B730 | 6.
For the turbine to trip on vibration protection, a high 1 signal must appear from any bearing and a high 2 signal from another bearing at the same time (this is done by connecting the computer to CH1) | 
Part two: Practical tests
Carry out the turbine trip test on a drop in bearing lubricating oil pressure to 0.6 PL | 1.
This is done by actually leaking oil by opening the oil leak valve inside the turbine body |
